rent_note: Local-authority level data in ONS table
council_tax_note: Average Band D set by local authorities in England, including adult social care and parish precepts

landlord_registration_or_licensing: National register required under the Renters' Rights Act via the "Register your rental property" service; regional rollout starts 15 Dec 2026 (not yet in force on the checking date). Local licensing schemes apply in designated areas

epc_future_standard: Government response confirms target of EPC C for all tenancies by 2030 using new EPCs, with a GBP 10,000 per-property spend cap; not yet in force

rent_increase_rule: Section 13 process (Form 4A) with at least 2 months' notice; once a year; tenant can challenge above open market rent

council_tax_note: Average Band D council tax in Wales (rounded figure as published) including county, police and community council elements

landlord_registration_or_licensing: All landlords with domestic tenancies must register with Rent Smart Wales; landlords who let or manage themselves also need a licence
deposit_protection_rule: Protect in an approved scheme within 30 days of receipt (England and Wales schemes)

mandatory_hmo_licensing_rule: 3 or more tenants, none related or from the same family
